items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And his brother Clark or Clark or whatever you want to call him? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he was a gamble, that's all he did was play piano and gamble...

ctx.x: Lewis Wade, he was another swim, what you call a pimp around that district. Yeah, he was a big time. Now, what about the piano player? Well, he played piano and he was good.
And his brother Clark or Clark or whatever you want to call him?

Yeah, he was a gamble, that's all he did was play piano and gamble and have, you know, just like Paul Gross. Paul Gross, you heard of him. He got a ballroom out there on, gamble and a room and I think it is. Yeah. Did he play music? No, he didn't play no music but he was hustling around, he gambled, you know.
